capabilities: Add color keys inside standard highlight and bold syntax
Render marker colors in Live Preview and Reading view
Customize the seven marker colors and highlight decoration in settings
Convert Style Obmd markers to inline HTML for the current note or the whole vault
extras: The vault-wide HTML conversion command modifies many files at once and cannot be undone with a single editor undo, so the README warns users to back up or commit the vault first. The README also notes the plugin had not yet been approved at the time of writing, with manual installation instructions provided.
intentEvidence: adds customizable colors to highlights and bold text
problem: Obsidian's built-in highlight and bold syntax has no way to assign specific colors to individual instances of highlighted or bold text.
summary: Color-marking plugin that adds customizable color keys to Obsidian's highlight and bold syntax, with commands to convert the styled Markdown to inline HTML.
